guide.title: How to Insulate a Tent for Winter
guide.description: Insulate from the ground up with a footprint, closed-cell foam, and stacked pads, block the wind, and keep condensation down without sealing the vents.
guide.metaTitle: How to Insulate a Tent for Winter
guide.metaDescription: How to insulate a tent for winter: start with the floor, add closed-cell foam and blankets, block the wind, and keep vents open so condensation stays low.
